articles.headline: China’s new five-year internet-tech plan targets AI chips and tighter oversight
articles.summary: China’s 2026-2030 plan pushes cybersecurity and informatization companies to develop advanced AI chips, foundation models, AI agents, and embodied intelligence while also tightening rules on data, algorithms, and competition. For businesses, this raises both opportunity and compliance pressure: chip demand and AI development support may increase, but operating in China will likely involve more scrutiny over data handling, antitrust, and platform practices.

articles.headline: Unitree’s sharp post-IPO drop raises concerns about robotics bubble risk
articles.summary: A steep decline in shares of China’s best-known humanoid robot maker has revived concerns about bubble risk and retail investor losses in the robotics sector. For businesses, the warning is that robotics enthusiasm may be running ahead of commercial readiness, affecting procurement, capital allocation, and supplier valuations.

articles.headline: UK broadband firms accused of failing low-income households on social tariffs
articles.summary: The report highlights a gap between affordability policy and actual broadband adoption, which matters for small businesses and home-based workers relying on connectivity. It also signals potential regulatory pressure on telecom providers to improve access and pricing transparency.
